steps: Replay via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: math.pde-fdm-fvm, typed inputs from the reference case} (or solve.direct once SC-00 lands): {mesh: 100, t: 0.2, tol: 5e-3} target sod → PASS with the plateau values (star pressure 0.30313, star velocity 0.92745, star densities 0.42632 / 0.26557 at the sample points, the undisturbed right state at x = 0.9) and L1 density error < 0.02 against the exact Riemann solution computed independently of the march — expected values from LeVeque, never from the solver's output.

Stability leg: {cfl: 1.5} target sod → NOT_COMPUTED invalid_input:cfl — a CFL request outside (0, 1] is refused by name on every hyperbolic target, an unstable march is never served; the run reports steps and maxCflUsed (within the declared 0.9 on the reference run) so the discipline is auditable from the result; target heat-cn declares Crank–Nicolson's unconditional stability in its regime rather than gating on it, and checks against the exact mode decay exp(−απ²t) within 2e-3.

Check the envelope: status, outputs within the declared tolerance, inputs echo (inputs used == inputs submitted); every target runs at mesh N and 2N under the mesh-doubling estimate contract — an unattainable tolerance refuses (not_converged) rather than serving the coarse march; TVD limiters / higher-order reconstruction and unstructured grids are named follow-on scope, unlisted rather than approximated.

Adversarial: NaN / negative-where-physical-positive / 1e300 input → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; missing mesh, t, or cfl → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field; a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted; a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
